name: Black Tax
description: Growing up in a tightly-knit black community has helped Thuli a lot - but when her ship finally starts to come in, and distant family starts coming out of the woodwork, how much longer does she need to keep paying her black tax?

videos.title: The Cost
videos.overview: What is Black Tax? When you're Thuli Dlamini, it means your father losing his pension and your parents moving in with you, and your cousin offloading her teenage son at your house.

videos.title: Maya Angelou
videos.overview: To mark Sizwe and Martha's relocation to her house, Thuli holds a ceremony to alert the ancestors, where a goat will be slaughtered. This leaves Sihle in an awkward position.

videos.title: First Day
videos.overview: Zakhele is newly enrolled in Sihle's school, and it feels like an alien planet. Sihle recruits him to raise money for a ridiculous cause. Meanwhile, Martha and Sizwe try to adjust to their new home.

videos.title: One Meeting Away
videos.overview: Fed up with her brother's slacker ways, Thuli decides to help Menzi attend a party, so he can pitch a lucrative idea to a famous DJ. Martha fires Thuli's domestic worker.

videos.title: Take Me To Church
videos.overview: Martha drags the whole family to church, where she's soon embroiled in competition with the head of the Women's League to collect blankets for charity.

videos.title: What Goes Around... And Around...
videos.overview: James tries to exploit Thuli's blackness to gain more clients. Thuli goes along with the plan, under a few conditions, until she realises it isn't all it's cracked up to be.

videos.title: Take A Parent To Work Day
videos.overview: To make him feel more productive, Thuli gets Sizwe a part-time job doing handyman work at her open houses. However, her dad's need to fix everything almost costs her a major sale.

videos.title: Back To School
videos.overview: Instead of helping Zakhele with a school assignment, Sizwe ends up taking over. He receives a grade that an overbearing grandfather deserves.

videos.title: Boots And Blackmail
videos.overview: After getting up on a soap box about the family overspending, Thuli is embarrassed when she falls in love with a pair of expensive boots and has to hide them. Menzi's back to his old tricks.

videos.title: Night After Night
videos.overview: Thuli hosts night vigils for a distant relative's funeral. She finds herself in charge of a madhouse, a befuddled James, an extravagant Antonio, and her parents' arch-nemesis — the Buthelezis

videos.title: Mi Kasie E Su Kasi
videos.overview: Menzi's roommates have had enough and kick him out when he lands an opportunity on a reality show and excludes them. Homeless, Menzi squats in one of Thuli's open houses.

videos.title: Sihle's Last Stand
videos.overview: After Martha ropes Sihle into helping her with her Women's Guild duties, the youngster's inner social justice warrior emerges. Menzi and Zakhele decide to go camping. Thuli tags along to keep them alive.

videos.title: Time After Time
videos.overview: Zakhele's mother, Julia, blows into town for a surprise visit. She's Thuli's best friend, a former Miss Soccer World, and a complete mess. Julia and Thuli butt heads on what being a parent means.

videos.title: Mo Moving, Mo Problems
videos.overview: Now that the family have moved further away from EVERYTHING, Thuli struggles to get the kids to school and get to work on time.

videos.title: Let Me Manifest
videos.overview: When Sihle gets an opportunity to go to Cape Town on a school trip, Thuli has to find an alternative stream of income to pay for it.

videos.title: Milli Not So Vanilli
videos.overview: Martha makes it her mission to infiltrate an exclusive group, Thuli interviews for prestigious position in one of James' other companies. Sihle and Lulu get drawn into a Milli Vanilli situation.

videos.title: Nightmare On Fox Street
videos.overview: When Thuli discovers that Lulu and Bra Hugo played a prank on Zakhele, she decides to get revenge on the neighbours. Sihle becomes obsessed that the new house isn't energy efficient.

videos.title: Suffer The Little Children
videos.overview: When Bra Hugo punishes Zakhele for playing outside after dark, Thuli questions the value of community parenting.

videos.title: One Man's Trash
videos.overview: Menzi is embarrassed at Sizwe's birthday party and goes to extreme lengths to restore his honour. Following some dubious tutelage by Martha, Sihle fails a history exam.

videos.title: No Church In The Wild
videos.overview: Sizwe lies to get out of church and hang out with Bra Hugo. Thuli believes she is being targeted by her night school teacher.

videos.title: No Such Thing...
videos.overview: Always looking for a golden opportunity, Menzi finds himself partnering with the most unlikely person — James' brother, Richard. Pastor Joshua finally invites Thuli out on a date.

videos.title: Oh, Brother, Leave Me Alone
videos.overview: As Thuli continues to struggle with her night school, Menzi complicates things when he joins her night class.

videos.title: Dance With Somebody
videos.overview: Sihle is having her Grade 11 Dance and decides to go with her best friend, Tammy. Nkanyiso and Thuli decide to chaperone.

videos.title: Baby Daddy Drama, Mama
videos.overview: Sihle's father comes for a visit, and ends up dragging mother and daughter into his obsessive fight to protect an area used for ancient cleansing rituals

videos.title: Happy Jesus' Birthday
videos.overview: Thuli loses her marbles when she has to spend Christmas with her boss. Sihle is tasked with finding presents for the surprise guests.

videos.title: A Tale Of Two Parties
videos.overview: With New Year's just around the corner, Thuli decides to mend her relationship with Shriya. Marth's idea of a fun night makes the rest of the family escape to the New Year's party next door.

videos.title: New Year, New House, Same Black Tax
videos.overview: Thuli quits in anger after being passed over for management position, then fights for her job.

videos.title: Thuli Interrupted
videos.overview: Thuli and Nkanyiso's relationship is exposed by Nomasonto

videos.title: That Fickle, Far-Flung Future
videos.overview: After a party, Thuli and Shriya devise a business idea to ease black tax for women. Menzi steals it.

videos.title: Grown-Ups And Consequences
videos.overview: Thuli juggles her business with Menzi and a deal for James, facing a life changing decision.

videos.title: Break-Ups & Bankruptcy
videos.overview: Thuli's unemployed family struggles. The church's money is stolen and Sizwe must recover it to protect Martha.

videos.title: Family Court
videos.overview: Thuli and Menzi's business thrives, James invests excluding Menzi, Thuli partners with James.

videos.title: Driving Her Crazy/Adulting 101
videos.overview: Sihle's driver's license celebration becomes a traditional thanksgiving but she misses her own party.

videos.title: Bet You Didn't See That Coming
videos.overview: Nkanyiso's family goes to a theme park; Nomasonto catches the gambling bug after Bra Hugo loses at poker.

videos.title: Makoti V Manoti
videos.overview: Menzi plans to break up with his girlfriend, but the family embraces her. He has to end the relationship himself.

videos.title: Partners
videos.overview: James takes credit for Thuli's business venture, so she must outsmart him to regain control.

videos.title: So, This Is What Happened...
videos.overview: Sizwe, late for her bursary interview, recounts a wild Matric Dance night.

videos.title: Under Pressure
videos.overview: After opening her catering company, Thuli struggles to find staff. Her family steps in, leading to chaos.

videos.title: Lost & Found
videos.overview: Martha suspects Sizwe of cheating while he secretly plans a vow renewal. Thuli and Nkanyiso save the ceremony.
